code_style: AI-code. AI-generated attributed rate-only leading-model inputs.
scope: Rate-only coherent local VVP exchange plus minimally gauged pion/kaon loop with one on-shell-factorized scalar rescattering amplitude and rho-omega mixing. No production source, sampler, normalization replacement or universal omitted-yield bound.

conventions.fkaon_note: The 2001 SU(3) comparison uses fK=fpi. The 2002 refinement s/(4 fpi fK), fK=1.22 fpi, is a separate declared numerical scenario, not an independent error bar.

pole_conventions: Rounded era pole inputs are explicit; the original exact numerical pole card was not printed. Photon comparisons retain this small input difference instead of tuning a rate normalization.
limitations: Minimal gauging fixes both loop tensors within this Lagrangian. It does not determine additional higher-derivative local timelike operators or hadronic form factors.

The selected linear-sigma rescattering scenario replaces the chiral term; adding an independent sigma amplitude would double count it. Zero scalar flavor mixing and a constant sigma width are explicit benchmark assumptions.
Kaon rescattering uses its leading chiral term. Flavor breaking, scalar kaon rescattering, empirical FV minus 2GV contact structures and higher chiral orders are not covered by the scalar scenarios.
Photon measurements test normalization and interference at q2=0. They do not bound virtual-only currents.

Natural rho/omega ancestors in the collision source are included in the parent inventory. Future exclusive replacement needs a source/ancestry audit and coherent sibling handling before any admission.
No detector, trigger, material, dimuon branching, production uncertainty or acceptance claim follows from this rate kernel.
